extracted.intended_audience: communications professionals, PR agencies, corporate communicators looking for press release distribution or regulatory disclosure services
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptive page about a company providing global press release distribution and regulatory disclosure services; useful for evaluating provider capabilities and expectations for distribution, audience targeting, and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release distribution and regulatory disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: For more than 50 years, Business Wire has been the global leader in press release distribution and regulatory disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims long-standing leadership (50+ years). Implies service scope includes both news distribution and formal regulatory disclosures for organizations; suggests reliability and institutional experience as evaluation factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience-targeted delivery via trusted sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver their news to the audiences most important to their business through the sources they trust most.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes targeting (reach relevant audiences) and distribution through trusted media/sources; for evaluating distribution services, consider how well the provider targets audiences and places content with credible outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global bureau/network capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: Over time, we've gone from a single office with one full time employee to more than 500 employees in 32 bureaus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights organizational scale and geographic footprint as a proxy for reach and local presence; when choosing a distributor, assess size, bureau locations, and staffing as indicators of capability to support wide or localized distribution.
